name: Tidewell Underworks
description: A drowned network of old Portbridge drainage works, smuggler storehouses, and failing tide machinery beneath the harbor. The sea reaches every low point eventually.

sluice_gate.name: Tidewell Sluice Gate
sluice_gate.description: A rusted floodgate separates the smugglers' dry tunnels from the older works. Salt water hisses through its seams, and a chain winch leads deeper beneath the harbor.

drowned_storehouse.name: Drowned Storehouse
drowned_storehouse.description: Half-submerged crates and rotting dock manifests fill a brick chamber that smugglers once kept dry. A few recent footprints prove someone is still willing to use it.

tide_gallery.name: Tide Gallery
tide_gallery.description: A narrow stone ledge follows a black tidal channel beneath the city. Water knocks softly against the wall below, carrying the smell of iron, algae, and something living.

cistern_steps.name: Cistern Steps
cistern_steps.description: Broad steps descend through an echoing cistern where every sound returns twice. A collapsed maintenance passage climbs south toward the old pumps.

pump_chamber.name: Old Pump Chamber
pump_chamber.description: Massive stopped pumps fill this vaulted chamber. Their brass housings bear municipal seals, while newer ropes and hooks show how the underworks became someone else's supply route.

blackwater_vault.name: Blackwater Vault
blackwater_vault.description: The lowest vault holds a pool black enough to hide its bottom. Old chains hang from the ceiling, and the water moves against the current as though guarding what was left here.
